direct_targets.citation: Voje KL, Saito-Kato M, Spanbauer TL. 2024. Evolution in fossil time series reconciles observations in micro- and macroevolution. Journal of Evolutionary Biology 37:1551-1562.
direct_targets.system: Cyclostephanos andinus fossil trait time series
direct_targets.mechanistic_reading: Reports a 12-year adaptation half-life and interprets the fit as rapid trait adaptation tracking a quickly and randomly moving optimum.

adjacent_not_direct.citation: Voje et al. 2026. Modeling within-lineage evolution as a consequence of changes in the adaptive landscape across short and long timescales. Evolution 80(9):2082-...
adjacent_not_direct.reason: Uses multivariate evoTS OU models with observed environmental variables and a different observation/causal design; the present univariate hidden-optimum congruence theorem does not automatically apply.

adjacent_not_direct.citation: Voje 2023. Fitting and evaluating univariate and multivariate models of within-lineage evolution. Paleobiology.
adjacent_not_direct.reason: Defines and documents OUBM and half-life practice but is not a qualifying empirical direct-target result for the primary denominator.

interpretation: Wave 1 establishes one definite direct empirical target but does not establish prevalence. Search-engine retrieval is not a systematic-review denominator, and further bibliographic/forward-citation waves are required before any field-wide frequency claim.
hard_stop: Do not count phylogenetic OU or multivariate observed-environment evoTS papers as directly affected by the current theorem.
